tables.title: Moves
rows: It thrusts out one hand、then the other、and each one releases a fan of orbs spread across 80 degrees. The orbs fly straight at a tenth of a Pillager arrow's speed、break on walls、so step through the gaps or put cover between you.

It only casts this when you're close. The regular Evoker's trap-summon sound plays、and after a slow wind-up seven fangs erupt in a ring around it; each hits for 15、knocks you back、applies Slowed、so roll out of the ring as soon as you hear the cue.

A bubble forms around it、takes every hit meant for the Evoker until it has absorbed 50 damage (up to 1.75 times that with four players). A new bubble can't go up until 23 秒onds after the last one did、so popping it fast buys a longer window on the boss.
Between 95%、60% health it calls in a squad of 1-2 Pillagers、2-6 Vindicators、up to 2 Royal Guards、sometimes an Enchanter、with no more than six alive from this spell. It can recast every 26 秒onds.
Below 60% health the squad is replaced by a bigger wave: four Vex、1-2 Pillagers、1-2 Royal Guards、an Enchanter、with up to 12 alive at once. It can recast every 32 秒onds.

Only while its bubble is down、it's above 15% health、it fades out、reappears at a random flee point in the arena、at most once every 15 秒onds. It's untargetable、invulnerable for about half a 秒ond as it vanishes.
Once its health drops below 15%、it teleports to the center of the arena a single time. It has already stopped chasing you at 25%、no longer retreats、so it finishes the fight from that spot.
